source: original (parallel to 7-7PreQuiz Q1, version B: ln 4+ln 7, 2 ln 5, -ln(1/6))

parts.label: a
parts.description: Express ln 4 + ln 7 in form ln k.
parts.notes: A1 for ln 28. Direct application of product rule ln a + ln b = ln(ab).

parts.label: b
parts.description: Express 2 ln 5 in form ln k.
parts.notes: A1 for ln 5^2 (intermediate, application of power rule). A1 for ln 25.

parts.label: c
parts.notes: A1 for an intermediate step such as ln(1/6)^(-1), -(ln 1 - ln 6), or -ln 6^(-1). A1 for ln 6.

source: original (parallel to 7-7PreQuiz Q2, version B: log_10 3 = p, log_10 5 = q)

parts.label: a
parts.description: Express log_10(45) in terms of p = log_10(3) and q = log_10(5).
parts.tolerance: Accept 2p + q. Argument 45 must be decomposed as 3^2 * 5.
parts.notes: M1 for correct application of product rule and/or power rule. A1 for an intermediate expression in log_10 3 and log_10 5 with arguments 3 and 5. A1 for 2p + q.

parts.label: b
parts.description: Express log_3(25) in terms of p = log_10(3) and q = log_10(5).
parts.notes: A1 for log_10(25)/log_10(3) or 2 log_10(5)/log_10(3) (change of base). A1 for 2q/p.

source: original (parallel to 7-7PreQuiz Q3, version B: log_10 b = 2/3)

parts.label: a
parts.notes: A1 for an intermediate form (log_10 1 - log_10 b, or log_10 b^(-1) = -log_10 b, or log_10 10^(-2/3)). A1 for -2/3.

parts.label: b
parts.notes: A1 for change of base log_1000 b = log_10 b / log_10 1000. A1 for substituting log_10 b = 2/3 and log_10 1000 = 3 to get (2/3)/3. A1 for 2/9.

source: original (parallel to 7-7PreQuiz Q4, version B: solve 2 ln x = ln 16 + 4)

parts.description: Solve 2 ln x = ln 16 + 4. Give answer as x = p e^q with p, q in Z+.
parts.tolerance: Accept x = 4 e^2 or x = 4e^2 or (p, q) = (4, 2). Other equivalent forms (e.g. sqrt(16 e^4)) earn intermediate marks but the requested form is x = pe^q with p, q positive integers.
parts.notes: M1 for using m ln x = ln x^m to write ln x^2 = ln 16 + 4. M1 for using ln a - ln b = ln(a/b) to combine into a single logarithmic expression. A1 for x^2/16 = e^4 (or x^2 = 16 e^4). A1 for x = sqrt(16 e^4) = 4 e^2 (with x > 0 noted). A1 for stating p = 4, q = 2. Method 2 (express 4 as 4 ln e first) earns the same marks.
